QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ba.literal: def basis (d r : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (bernsteinPolynomial ℝ d r).eval t

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ca.literal: def casteljau (d : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ := (casteljauStep t ^ d) c i
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ca.normalized: d iterations of the coefficient-row update c_i -> (1-t)c_i+t*c_(i+1), read at index i

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.le.literal: def leftRestriction (u : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ := casteljau i c u 0
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.le.normalized: left edge of the exact de Casteljau triangle

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ri.literal: def rightRestriction (d : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ := leftRestriction (1-u) (fun r => c (d-r)) (d-i)
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ri.normalized: right edge, with natural truncated subtraction and coefficient order reversal

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.re.literal: def restrictCoefficients (d : ℕ) (u v : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ := leftRestriction ((v-u)/(1-u)) (rightRestriction d u c)
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.re.normalized: the two successive exact-real subdivisions at u and (v-u)/(1-u)

formal_context.target: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Fintype β] (k M : ℕ) (a h : ℝ), 0 < h → ∀ (u : α → ℕ) (v : β → ℕ), (∀ y, v y < M) → (@QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.FactorsThrough α β (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.HermiteBond k) inferInstance (fun x y => QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.smoothInitial k (a + h * ((M * u x + v y : ℕ) : ℝ)))) ∧ (Fintype.card (QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.HermiteBond k) = 8 * k + 12) ∧ (Matrix.rank (fun x y => QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.smoothInitial k (a + h * ((M * u x + v y : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤ 8 * k + 12)

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.Fact.literal: def FactorsThrough [Fintype ι] (F : Matrix α β ℝ) : Prop := ∃ A : Matrix α ι ℝ, ∃ B : Matrix ι β ℝ, F = A * B
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.Fact.normalized: finite-width matrix factorization, retaining both factor witnesses

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.Herm.literal: abbrev HermiteBond (k : ℕ) := Sum (Sum (Fin 2 × Unit) ((Sum (Fin 2) (Fin 2)) × Fin (2*k+2))) (Fin 2 × Unit)
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.Herm.normalized: left width 2*1, middle width (2+2)*(2k+2), right width 2*1, joined by direct sums

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.s.normalized: the specific source Hermite bridge of degree at most 2*k+1, matching the derivative jets of exp at -1 and exp(-x) at 0; only the existing degree theorem and value at zero enter this construction

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.s.literal: def smoothInitial (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ := if p < -1 then Real.exp p else if p ≤ 0 then (sourceInterpolant k).eval p else Real.exp (-p)
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermitePolynomial.s.normalized: the actual library exponential-polynomial-exponential datum, with bridge value 1 at zero; an equal strict-middle form uses p<0 and the right exponential at zero

Matrix.rank.normalized: rank of the real matrix, used with finite column type; exact algebraic width bound only

Nat.ceil.normalized: natural-valued ceiling; negative real inputs saturate to zero
